title: Water Minecart
description: "I wanna pour water into the cart…"
body:
_Interactive stress-relief mod that lets you pour water into a minecart._ 

**Features**

- Fill and collect water using a bucket.

- Ride a water-filled minecart to extinguish yourself or other mobs.

- Endermen, Blazes, and Snow Golems take damage inside a Minecart with Water.

- The Minecart with Water prevents block destruction when a Creeper or any other exploding entity detonates inside it.

- The Minecart with Water item is available in the Transportation tab.
 

**Item/Entity Name:** `water_minecart`
